test_title: PYST 32: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 19 Feb, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
A dice has its faces marked by leers U, V, W, X, Y and Z. Two different positions of the same dice are shown. Select the leer that will be on the face opposite to the one having U?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f5c435594d1489cdd860898cb7b74ffc5ffc1c37521030c774bc365864d8399.png]
solution:
Logic: If two dice are shown with two common faces in the same relative position, then the face opposite to the remaining face is the opposite of give face.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn010.adda247.com/fc05c558-3e1b-4642-aef4-13702144786c.png] 

So, the opposite of U is V.
